# Copyright Compliance

## Procedure
Require asset provenance, commercial rights, attribution and restrictions where applicable; unknown material asset rights means FAIL. This is risk screening, not legal advice.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
